name: Onur Erol
bio: Onur Erol graduated from the Music Education Department of Marmara University. In 2001, he started teaching music at a private institution. He founded the “Do It Yourself, Play It Yourself” workshop, where he produces Orff instruments and gives pedagogical training on how to make instruments. In 2015, he created the YouTube channel “Karamela Sepeti” with videos of children’s songs he wrote. The channel is loved by families and educators. Onur Erol is still an educator in the field of Orff Schulwerk, and continues to produce content for children, families, and teachers.
